items.difficulty_reason: 10 行、伪凝聚 ⇒ 导出完备：伪凝聚 K 由有限自由 A-模的上方有界复形代表；每个 H^n(K) 是有限自由模的子商，A 导出完备时由 serre-subcategory 引理 (1) 也导出完备；再由同引理 (2)，上同调全导出完备的复形本身导出完备。括注（I-进完备 ⇒ 导出完备）由 complete-derived-complete 引理解释。承重全在 span 内；2 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-pseudo-coherent-is-derived-complete (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 26125-26130

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the representation of a pseudo-coherent object by a bounded above complex of finite free modules, the derived completeness of each cohomology group from part (1) of the Serre-subcategory lemma applied to the derived complete coefficient ring, and the derived completeness of the complex itself from part (2) of the same lemma (source lines 26132-26141)
